title: Chinese Dialects
tagline: Dialect and language, classifying the dialects, Mandarin dialects, Wu, Cantonese, Min and Hakka, Xiang, Gan, Hui and Pinghua, dialect words and grammar, dialects today, and recording a dialect
summary: Most Chinese people grow up with a dialect as well as Putonghua, and the dialects differ from one another as much as the languages of Europe. This course explains how Chinese dialects are classified and described, surveys the major groups from the Mandarin dialects to Wu, Cantonese, Min and Hakka with their history and features, compares their words and grammar, and discusses dialects in today’s society and how to record one’s own.

chapters.title: Dialect and language
chapters.summary: What makes a dialect a dialect, mutual intelligibility, and the political and cultural sense of “Chinese”.

chapters.title: Classifying the dialects
chapters.summary: Criteria for classification, the *Language Atlas of China*, and the ten dialect groups.

chapters.title: Mandarin dialects
chapters.summary: The eight Mandarin subgroups, from Northeastern and Beijing Mandarin to Southwestern and Jianghuai Mandarin, and the Jin group.

chapters.title: Wu
chapters.summary: Shanghainese, the Suzhou dialect and the other Wu dialects, their voiced initials and their tone sandhi.

chapters.title: Cantonese and Yue
chapters.summary: Cantonese and the Yue dialects, their nine tones and entering-tone finals, and written Cantonese.

chapters.title: Min and Hakka
chapters.summary: The Min dialects of Fujian, Taiwan and Hainan with their literary and colloquial readings, and Hakka.

chapters.title: Xiang, Gan, Hui and Pinghua
chapters.summary: The other southern groups and the features that set them apart.

chapters.title: Dialect words and grammar
chapters.summary: Comparing words, grammatical particles and word order across the dialects.

chapters.title: Dialects today
chapters.summary: Putonghua and the dialects in a mobile society, the decline of dialects, and efforts to record and preserve them.

chapters.title: Recording a dialect
chapters.summary: How to record a dialect: the standard character list for dialect surveys, transcription and audio recording.
